name: jiti
description: Runtime typescript and ESM support for Node.js

scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier -c src lib test stubs
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix . && prettier -w src lib test stubs
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm test && changelogen --release --push && npm publish --tag 1x
scripts.test: pnpm lint && vitest run --coverage && pnpm test:bun
